verified_behavior: The mature pricing_economics_authority remains the only deterministic calculator; Phase 2 wraps its real output instead of creating a second price calculator.

price, landed cost, platform fee, payment fee, fulfillment, affiliate commission, tax and refund allowance are all explicitly accounted for; missing values remain MISSING_INPUT while explicit zero remains valid.
A legacy calculation-level READY may remain for backward compatibility, but phase2_business_status is independently READY/TO_VERIFY and blocks false FULL business readiness.
Pricing Decision and Offer Decision require explicit WHAT / WHY / EVIDENCE / TRADEOFF / EXECUTION / MEASUREMENT. Math alone cannot author either decision.
Market price bands, price valleys and price/configuration evidence cannot become the product price or recommendation without an explicit Agent Pricing Decision.
Legacy sensitivity defaults such as synthetic discount or affiliate-rate steps remain compatibility analysis and cannot become an Offer decision.
Missing CVR leaves break-even CPC unresolved while CPA/ROAS may remain available when their own inputs and operating target are explicit.
Missing target contribution preserves zero-contribution break-even numbers only as BASELINE_ZERO_CONTRIBUTION_FLOOR_ONLY; those numbers are not Ads/Offer operating boundaries.

Required economics inputs plus Pricing/Offer decisions carry REQ-088 lineage fields through source/type/recency/exact fact/interpretation/confidence/assumption boundary/downstream/conflict/proof object.

The same Phase 2 Economics/Offer object is projected into FULL Strategy; Strategy delivery validation becomes INCOMPLETE when required economics input, Pricing decision or Offer decision is incomplete.
Seven-tool Product Strategy distinguishes calculation_status from business_readiness_status and cannot report Pricing READY merely because arithmetic calculated.
Canonical graph already prefers pricing_economics_authority.json over legacy offer_economics.json, so Phase 2 enriches the existing canonical ECONOMICS authority rather than changing graph parentage.
